evals.name: Existing root check owns monorepo concurrency
evals.prompt: Create init.sh for a monorepo whose existing pnpm run check covers format:check, lint, typecheck, test and build with native workspace concurrency. AGENTS.md forbids source fixes and installs.
evals.expected_output: Simple strict Bash wrapper, syntax and git checks, then pnpm run check.
expectations: No custom scheduler, runtime discovery, fixes or installs

evals.name: No check means explicit coverage gap
evals.prompt: Create a harness for a docs-only repository without package manifests or a project test command.
evals.expected_output: Minimal routed instructions and syntax/whitespace checks with a disclosed coverage boundary.
expectations: Does not fabricate a build or test command
Does not claim full application verification
Does not create empty task/spec trees

evals.name: Independent work retains index without state mirrors
evals.prompt: We need a roadmap and two developers can work on independent tasks. Generate the local task conventions.
evals.expected_output: Navigation index, separate task-local status/owners/dependencies, no root progress log.
expectations: Permanent project-local numeric IDs allocated in the canonical checkout; no one-active limit
Index changes only for roadmap membership/scope
Notes task files do not prevent source conflicts

evals.name: Approved migration preserves conflicting history
evals.prompt: Migrate our v1 harness to v2. Feature index says done but progress says blocked; task owner has not reconciled it yet.
evals.expected_output: Ask the owner to resolve conflicting state before finalizing migration; preserve original history.
expectations: Does not guess status or delete history

evals.name: Reuse the external tracker
evals.prompt: The team’s accessible issue tracker already owns acceptance, status, dependencies and handoff. Our specs and architecture are canonical. Simplify the harness.
evals.expected_output: Reuse tracker and docs, keep short routes and verification; no local task mirror.
expectations: No duplicate progress or status index
Keeps durable intent separate from observed code

evals.name: Permanent IDs survive task lifecycle
evals.prompt: Upgrade our local tasks to issue-style IDs, then rename task #42 and remove completed task #99 before creating new work.
evals.expected_output: Use the allocator for approved migration and creation, preserve #42 across rename, retain the committed high-water counter so #99 is never reused.
expectations: Never derives identity from list order or slug
Preserves task state, filenames and existing links during migration
Uses #ID - Title in task lists and handoffs
Coordinates allocation in one canonical checkout before parallel worktrees
